Understanding Spark UI, Jetty, and Jersey

  • Spark UI: Provides a web interface to monitor jobs. It runs inside embedded Jetty, a lightweight web server.

  • Jetty: Serves HTTP requests using Java Servlets, which are classes implementing the javax.servlet.Servlet interface.

  • Jersey: Spark’s REST endpoints in the UI use Jersey. In Spark 3.x, it relies on Jersey 2.x, which works with javax.servlet.

Key point: Spark 3.x is tightly coupled with javax.servlet, not the newer jakarta.servlet.

check this paper: https://medium.com/@sauravchoudhary78/migrating-to-jdk-17-navigating-spark-servlets-and-the-jakarta-vs-javax-maze-9e3da3110422
